context_diary: The account_lookup function allows querying platform accounts by type (USER, AGENT, ADMIN) with optional filters like currency. It returns limited results by default to prevent overload, showing total match counts. The platform contains three distinct account hierarchies: users (8,497+), agents (1,498), and admins (1). Currency data is stored per user account. When specific filter matches are empty, broadening the search reveals available data patterns. The function supports pagination through limit parameters and returns structured JSON with status, counts, and data arrays.
